items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: And she had taken me to all these places and she could explain the whole history of these things.

ctx.x: You didn't see him fight, though?

No, they just introduced him. And two or three days afterwards or so he was to fight Patterson. They had a plane of paper. Then I went and saw Madame Tussauds at Wax Museum. And they had a lady, her husband was a piano player. He was a piano player. His name is Graham. And his wife is named Molly. You know people. And she had taken me to all these places and she could explain the whole history of these things. I went to the Westminster. I went to St. Paul's Cathedral. And inside these churches they have different…
Just asking about your father in Chicago.
